notes:
BUILD 59
- Fishing Port: a boardwalk on piles at the shore, marked on the map. A walk in from the land, a deck with a boat shed and two survivor traders, and a pier running out to a low jetty.
- Dinghy: buy one at the Boat Shed for 125 scrap and it is waiting at the end of the jetty. E to get in, W / S ahead and astern, A / D to steer, the mouse looks around, E to get out. Six slots of storage under the bow. It needs no fuel and stops when it runs onto the shore.
- The Boat Shed also trades: low grade fuel, rope, tarp and cooked meat for scrap, and buys raw meat and animal fat.
- /boat (dev mode) drops a dinghy where you are looking.
- The port is part of the island itself, so it is there in your existing save too.
